description: TCS-off surface, safe generic HIDDEN. No dedicated surface-start signal is confirmed for TCSOFF in this integration, so the hidden condition is modeled with the HUD not in a normal powered state (val_power not POWER_ON(3)). No fabricated vehicle-condition warning is asserted because the vehicle-condition indicator (sta_vehicleConditionShow) is only driven by door status while val_gear==1.

mem.desc: power not POWER_ON(3), HUD not in operational state
